allow: PowerShell($sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew\(\); $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5000/api/history?symbol=BTC&interval=1m&period=1d&source=hyperliquid" -TimeoutSec 30 -UseBasicParsing; $j = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; [PSCustomObject]@{ok=$j.ok; candle_count=$j.data.Count; elapsed_ms=$sw.ElapsedMilliseconds; first_time=$j.data[0].time; last_time=$j.data[-1].time})
